name: sol_am_da_1
description: Donation/balance-manipulation attack via reliance on token.balanceOf instead of internal accounting
question: The source file in `source` computes share price, exchange rate, collateral value, or reward distribution using `balance`/`balanceOf(address(this))` of a token directly instead of maintaining an internal accounting variable that tracks deposits, so an attacker can donate or directly transfer tokens to the contract to inflate the balance and manipulate calculations such as shares-per-token minted or rewards owed, causing incorrect accounting, share dilution, or fund loss for other users, excluding cases where the contract already maintains and uses an internally tracked balance/deposit variable for these calculations instead of the live token balance.
criteria: deposit()/mint() computes shares = amount * totalSupply() / IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) instead of using an internally tracked total deposited amount
withdraw()/redeem() calculates payout based on IERC20(asset).balanceOf(address(this)) rather than a stored accounting balance, allowing donation-inflated ratios
reward distribution logic divides by token.balanceOf(address(this)) to compute reward-per-share, letting an attacker donate tokens to skew rewardPerToken calculations
a vault's exchangeRate() or pricePerShare() reads balanceOf(address(this)) directly with no internal ledger of user deposits, enabling a first-depositor donation attack to break share minting
